title: Effect of Guided Tissue Regeneration on Newly Formed Bone and Cementum in Periapical Tissue Healing after Endodontic Surgery: An In Vivo Study in the Cat
authors: Artzi Z, Wasersprung N, Weinreb M, Steigmann M, Prasad HS, Tsesis I. J Endod. 2012 Feb;38(2):163-9. doi: 10.1016/j.joen.2011.10.002.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “There was significantly more bone formation after su rgical endodontic treatment when membrane and bone grafts were used as compared with bone grafts only or unfilled control sites. However, it appears that the key factor to the enhanced tissue regeneration is the membrane and not the grafted biomaterial” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
